items.title: Samsung Unveils Its First Clip-On TWS, Galaxy Buds On
items.summary: Samsung quietly unveiled the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on true wireless earbuds with an open-ear design, TwinBoost speakers and Audio Leakage Reduction. The buds offer 9.5 hours of playback, three-mic calls with a bone-conduction Voice Pickup sensor, and Gemini Live support, launching in South Korea on October 27.

items.title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) Review: Best Clip-On, Hard to Justify at $299
items.summary: SoundGuys tested the second-generation Bose Ultra Open Earbuds and found they fix most original flaws with a new driver for deeper bass, improved mics and longer 9-hour battery life. The $299 price remains hard to justify against a fast-growing field of better-value clip-on alternatives.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open Open Pre-Booking in India at Rs 999
items.summary: Noise opened pre-bookings for its first Sound by Bose clip-on open-ear TWS, the Master Buds Open, priced from Rs 7,999 at launch on October 23. The earbuds feature a C-bridge design, 10.8mm driver, 4-mic ENC and up to 28 hours of playback with Bose-tuned Dynamic EQ.

items.title: OPPO Enco X3s Premium TWS Earbuds Launched Globally
items.summary: OPPO launched the Enco X3s premium true wireless earbuds globally alongside the Find X9 series, starting at EUR 129. The buds offer up to 45 hours of playback, dual dynamic drivers with dual DACs, Dynaudio tuning, 55dB ANC and Hi-Res Audio via the LDHC 5.0 codec.

items.title: Fairphone Fairbuds 2 Set for October 14 Launch With Modular Repairability and LDAC
items.summary: Fairphone will unveil the Fairbuds 2 on October 14 with seven fully replaceable modular parts and new Sony LDAC codec support alongside SBC and AAC. Priced at EUR 119 in Europe and USD 119 in the US, the repairable TWS challenge less serviceable flagship earbuds.

items.title: Omdia: OWS Shipments Grow 12% as TWS Market Stays Flat in Q2 2026
items.summary: Omdia reports global true wireless stereo shipments fell 0.7% year-on-year to 82.1 million in Q2 2026, the first decline since 2023, while open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1 million. Apple led with 20.5% share; clip-on OWS made up 61% of the category.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro (2026) Review: Flagship ANC With Galaxy-Only AI
items.summary: TopCrate rates the Galaxy Buds 4 Pro 4.5/5, praising six-mic ANC close to AirPods Pro, very good sound and IP57 durability with AI live translation and head gestures. The standout features activate only on Galaxy phones, limiting value for iPhone and non-Galaxy Android users.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Small, Smart, and Finally Fitting Properly
items.summary: The Review Bench finds the WF-1000XM6 deliver class-leading transparency and best-in-class Android codec support with a 12% smaller shell that finally fits. Touch controls are a regression and there is no Auracast, but they remain the default pick for Android-first buyers.

items.title: Apple AirPods Pro 3 Review: ANC, Heart Rate and Live Translation
items.summary: Showmetech's full analysis highlights the AirPods Pro 3's heart-rate sensor using a PPG reading 256 times per second and on-device Live Translation across supported languages. The buds add Conversation Awareness and IP57 durability while staying deepest within the Apple ecosystem.

items.title: CMF Buds Pro 2 Review: Budget Earphones in Name Only
items.summary: Position Is Everything praises the CMF Buds Pro 2's confident 50dB adaptive ANC, LDAC support and a useful Smart Dial case at a budget price. Transparency and outdoor call quality trail premium Sony, Bose and Apple models, but the everyday package overdelivers for the money.
